title: Core homepage source correction
details: Removes the self-triggering v161 course-title watcher that could prevent Evia from loading
Renders the concise course identity directly from the core homepage
Renders Time, Course, Learn and Test directly from the core arch renderer

summary: Evia v162 restores loading and moves the final homepage identity and arch labels into the core renderer instead of repainting older UI after launch.
